# Temperature sensor — Phase 2 (generated by sensor_report.py)

Error after a 1-point calibration at 27 °C with an ideal-PTAT model, on VPTAT/VBG (ADC quantization ±1.2 °C not included).

## Corners (7 corners × 3 supplies): 21 runs

| Quantity | min | max | mean | σ |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| VPTAT at 27 °C (V) | 0.5999 | 0.6006 | 0.6004 | 0.2 mV |
| VPTAT slope (mV/°C) | 1.946 | 1.968 | 1.956 | 0.004 |
| worst temperature error over −40…125 °C (°C) | 1.47 | 2.58 | 2.22 | 0.22 |

## Monte Carlo (mismatch, tt, per seed): 100 runs

| Quantity | min | max | mean | σ |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| VPTAT at 27 °C (V) | 0.5483 | 0.6416 | 0.5993 | 18.0 mV |
| VPTAT slope (mV/°C) | 1.869 | 2.031 | 1.956 | 0.032 |
| worst temperature error over −40…125 °C (°C) | 0.92 | 8.33 | 3.18 | 1.35 |

## Calibration (Monte Carlo, the same 100 seeds)

| Calibration | worst error over −40…125 °C | |
|---|---|---|
| 1 point (27 °C), ideal-PTAT model | mean 3.2 °C, 95th percentile 5.4 °C; **10 % of seeds exceed ±5 °C** | B13 (max ±5 °C) not met for all chips |
| 2 points (27 °C and 85 °C), linear | worst 2.65 °C, 95th percentile 2.0 °C | ✅ |

The mismatch mostly changes the slope of VPTAT/VBG (σ of the VPTAT slope 0.032 mV/°C = 1.6 %). The corners alone
stay within 2.6 °C with 1 point.
